cumpraAnteriores: Complete the previous steps to unlock.

info.porque1: Checks the integrity of the insulation between the winding and the frame.
info.porque2: Detects moisture, contamination and aging before they turn into a failure.
info.resultados2: Motors in good condition: hundreds of MΩ to GΩ.
info.observar1: Rising curve = dielectric absorption → dry/good insulation.
info.observar2: Flat curve or low value = moisture or contamination.
info.observar3: Temperature strongly affects the reading — always correct to 40 °C.

instrutor.notaQualidade: Lower levels turn off bloom/shadows and render on demand — ideal for phones and low-end PCs.
instrutor.ajudaCalibrar: Turn it on and click the point on the motor (terminal box for LINE, frame for EARTH); the coordinate is copied — send it to me and I will save the anchors.
